import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_dist = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
# Sort by age numerically
age_order = df.drop_duplicates('AlterVHundLang').sort_values('AlterVHundSort')['AlterVHundLang']
age_dist = age_dist.reindex(age_order).dropna()
ax2.bar(range(len(age_dist)), age_dist.values, color=sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_dist)))
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_dist)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([a.replace('-Jährige', '').replace('und mehr', '+') for a in age_dist.index], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors3 = sns.color_palette('Spectral', len(district_counts))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 30, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# Plot 4: Dog Gender Distribution with Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a crosstab of dog gender vs owner gender
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexHundLang'], df['SexLang'])
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Gender')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Owner Gender')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
